explication: Quasar is a Windows remote-administration application: an operator uses the server interface to manage connected client machines, with shared message types and a TCP/TLS transport. The graph highlights the file-management workflow and the major documented capabilities. Some feature branches are documented in the README but their wiring was not sampled; those relationships are shown as unverified rather than asserted as source-level calls.
